text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Guh! My heart wants to sprint forward! And 
yet... my legs won't move...!! I never 
knew falling short could hurt this much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Watching the other girls aiming for the 
Mile CS made me realize something, though. 
Everyone is fighting their way up from 
their own hardships.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The deeper the despair, the greater the 
hope that can be found! My rising up from 
this... that very sight will surely show 
hope to the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I can't hold my breath, I just need to 
increase my explosive power! That's the 
best way for me to run right now!
